acceptance_criteria: header:Subject:asText returns decoded subject string; header:From:asAddresses returns address array; invalid form combo returns invalidArguments; test with RFC §4.1.3 examples
description: RFC 8621 §4.1.2–4.1.3 defines dynamic property names like 'header:From:asAddresses', 'header:Date:asDate', 'header:X-Custom:asText'. Valid forms: header:<name> (raw), header:<name>:asText, header:<name>:asAddresses, header:<name>:asDate, header:<name>:asMessageIds, header:<name>:asURLs, header:<name>:all (returns array). Currently email.rs lines 44–50 property parsing does not intercept these; they would fail to serialize since Email struct has no dynamic fields. Implementation requires: (1) detecting header: prefix in property list, (2) extracting from raw MIME headers at get time, (3) applying the named form (asText = unfold/decode, asAddresses = parse RFC 5322 address list, etc.).
title: Email/get: dynamic header: property syntax
